change_summary: Owner authorized and executed roadmap phases 2 to 5 of the AI assistant with a single consolidated authorization ('وافقت على التفويض الموحّد بالخيارات الموصى بها', choices [1:A][2:A][3:A][4:A]): consolidated execution; build cloud sharing with both toggles disabled and no transmission; no external libraries; NEEDS-VALIDATION gates left open.

Phase 2 work modes: added AI/Orchestration (WorkMode, WorkModeResolver, FactPackage, NumberAdjudicator) over the existing router without changing RouteScorer decisions; the built-in permanently adjudicates every final number against a fact package; work-mode and adjudication transparency added to route results and the chat UI; manual route choice retained; no database writes.

Phase 3 safe cloud sharing: added AI/Privacy (ApprovedPrivacyWording, RedactionValidator, QuestionRedactor, CloudShareGuard, CloudPromptGuard). CloudSharingEnabled is a separate toggle from the cloud model, both default false; no request is prepared or sent unless both are on and mandatory redaction has run; only a redacted anonymous summary is used, with no store context; the exact approved privacy wording is shown in settings; a final independent pre-HTTP guard was added in CloudLlmProvider. Nothing was actually sent.

Phase 4 perception: added AI/Perception (PerceptionCandidate, PerceptionCandidateExtractor, PerceptionAdjudicator) using only standard .NET; perception results remain candidates until the built-in adjudicates them against known products; WrittenToDatabase stays false.

Phase 5 semantic: added AI/Semantic (SemanticIntent, SemanticIntentResolver, SemanticMemory) for local intent understanding and follow-up reference resolution, with a short local conversation memory; no stored business data touched and nothing sent externally; shared-core dialect quality remains NEEDS-VALIDATION.

Verification: build 0 errors; tests 346/346 (24 domain + 322 integration, including 33 new synthetic-data phases 2-5 tests); three paths and manual choice retained; no cloud key enabled; no real merchant database queried and no real-device restore claimed.

Added deterministic analytics in BuiltInAssistant (average sale, day/week comparison, overdue debts, period totals) from the existing store snapshot with no free-form SQL and no numbers generated from text; added previous-week fields to the snapshot.

Added two read-only tools to BuiltInToolRegistry (EmbeddedAnalyticsTool, ProductLookupTool) with no database writes; tool answers keep the 'أدوات' intent so number questions remain protected from model replacement.
Added DialectSynonyms.cs for shared-core Algerian Arabic conversation synonyms in normalized form; no regional dictionaries added.

review_findings: v0.6.17 records the executed roadmap phases 2 to 5 of the assistant architecture. Earlier versions did not claim code built, tested, deployed or verified unless stated here.
Build: dotnet build Wizz.sln -c Release --no-restore -v minimal = 0 errors (pre-existing StyleCop warnings only).

Tests: dotnet test Wizz.sln -c Release --no-restore = Domain 24/24; Integration 322/322 (346 total), up from a 313 baseline; includes 33 new synthetic-data tests for phases 2 to 5. No test used a real merchant database or claimed a real-device restore.

Number adjudication verified: a drafted answer containing a number absent from the built-in fact package is rejected and the built-in text is restored; a draft using only built-in numbers is accepted.

Cloud path verified closed by default: CloudShareGuard.TryPrepare returns null unless CloudSharingEnabled is on; the router gates cloud on both toggles; CloudPromptGuard blocks forbidden data before any HTTP; nothing was sent and no cloud key was configured.

Perception verified read-only and adjudicated: known product with matching price accepted, unknown product or price mismatch rejected, cloud-sourced candidate gains no extra trust, and WrittenToDatabase stays false.

Semantic understanding and local memory verified with synthetic questions; follow-up reference resolved from remembered subject; disabled memory stores nothing. Shared-core dialect quality remains NEEDS-VALIDATION.
RouteScorer decisions and the three paths (embedded/local/cloud) were not altered; manual route choice and the 'أدوات' precision protection remain intact.
Roadmap phase 6 (professional French) is DEFERRED and was not touched; NEEDS-VALIDATION gates remain open.
Build: dotnet build Wizz.sln -c Release --no-restore -v minimal = 0 errors (pre-existing StyleCop warnings only).

Phase 1 verification used synthetic data only; no real merchant database was queried for these tests and no real-device restore is claimed.
Number guard preserved: tool answers carry the 'أدوات' intent so IsPrecisionAnswer stays true and analytical/local/cloud routing cannot replace embedded numbers.
No external transmission: nothing was sent to any cloud service and no cloud-model or cloud-sharing toggle was enabled.
Roadmap phases 2 to 6 remain unauthorized; professional French (phase 6) is deferred. General execution authorization stays NOT AUTHORIZED except the documented limited scopes.
Browser verification on a synthetic-only SQLite database at localhost:5183: /cash, /purchases, /reports (cash and purchases tabs) and /settings render with no console errors.
Permission check: a cashier sees only the home, sales, debts, cash, stock and AI navigation links; /purchases, /reports and /settings redirect to /access-denied, while /cash stays accessible.
Cost hiding verified in code through CurrentUser.HasPermissionAsync(ViewPurchaseCosts) in the purchases page and the purchases report tab.
Close behaviour verified in code: counting runs only when store.CashDrawerEnabled and a counted cash value is supplied; otherwise the legacy shift.Close() path is used.
Backup limitation: backups taken before Phase 3 have no CashMovements table and are rejected after upgrade; no claim of restorability is made.
